The '''Botori''', also known as the '''Botor''', were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that inhabited around two dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Since the early period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Botori and the [[Dawferim]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of the nearby [[Daupherm Planet States]] engaged in many wars, some of which lasted for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. Around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the Botor Enclave declared its independence from both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Botori,<ref name="TEA" /> also known as the Botor,<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> were an [[Bear/Legends|ursine]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Botori in the galaxy==
[[File:Daupherm_Planet_States_-_Botor_Enclave.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Botori inhabited around two dozen star systems in the Botor Enclave.]]
The Botori inhabited approximately two dozen [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the fringes of a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] inside the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Those systems included the [[Botor system/Legends|Botor system]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Kerensik system/Legends|Kerensik system]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerensik]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="DES" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="DE3">[[Dark Empire 3|''Dark Empire'' 3]]</ref> [[Kane Griggs]].<ref name="DES" />

Since accepting the status of an [[Allied Region]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the early period of that government, the Botori and their ancient rival,<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Dawferim]]<ref name="DES" /> Humans of the nearby [[Daupherm Planet States]] area, engaged in at least forty wars, with some of them lasting for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]. A large number of laws and traditions regulating nearly every aspect of the conflicts, including vendettas, [[Privateer/Legends|privateering]], and all-out war, emerged over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]. Both the Republic and its successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], only intervened in the Botor-Daupherm conflicts when they began to spill over into the larger [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

By [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="10 ABY">The ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'' is set six [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Botor Enclave and the Dawferim had engaged in a five-hundred-[[Standard year/Legends|years]]-long small-scale [[Daupherm-Boton Conflict|feud]]. Also by that [[Time/Legends|time]], the systems of the Botor Enclave grouped together and formed a protective federation due to the lack of a centralized [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government and the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|conflict]] between the Empire and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DES" /> In the process, the Botor Enclave also declared its independence from both the Empire and the New Republic.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Botori were first mentioned as the "Botor" in the ''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]'', [[Michael Allen Horne]]'s [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="DES" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] described the inhabitants of the Botor Enclave as a distinct species and named them Botori.<ref name="TEA" />
